text:
emily: Heads-up: trying to publish sdk-js for the sample app but regendiff flagged a minor bump. The only change is key ordering inside generated example objects.

raj: paste the diff?

emily: small snippet from regendiff:
```diff
-  examples:
-    - value: {
-        "role": "user",
-        "content": "ping"
-      }
+  examples:
+    - value: {
+        "content": "ping",
+        "role": "user"
+      }
```No surface types changed. Looks like typegen's stable-serialize reorder.

kai: we've seen this churn. Two choices: manual override by release-ops, or make regendiff ignore example-object key ordering. The latter prevents future noise.

regendiff-bot: Automated: regen diff detected in packages/sdk-js/src/generated/examples/ChatExamples.ts. Classified: docs/examples. Semver-impact (file-lens): minor.

ci-bot: CI publish pipeline #1456 failed at regendiff gate: `semver-check: candidate minor bump detected`.

release-ops: I can approve a one-off override if there's a PR explaining why.

emily: I'll open a tiny PR in dev-tools that canonicalizes example objects before computing diffs and adds an opt-in marker `// regendiff: ignore-example-order` in generated files. Pushing now.

raj: Nice. If you include tests for nested maps that'll be ideal. Also add a short note in the release playbook so release-ops know to expect this.

emily: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/pull/344 — adds canonicalizer + unit tests. Requesting quick review.

regendiff-bot: New commit 4b1c2 applied. Re-running regendiff...

ci-bot: CI publish pipeline #1457 re-run: regendiff step reports "example ordering ignored". No semver bump detected.

release-ops: Override not needed. Publish can proceed.

emily: Running `yarn lerna publish from-package --yes` now. Thanks team.

kai: Follow-ups: (1) land canonicalizer and backfill other SDKs, (2) update release docs, (3) consider harmonizing typegen stringify behavior with dev-tools.

emily: Filed follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/issues/156 - expand canonicalization and audit other generated docs.

ci-bot: publish pipeline #1457 passed. Artifacts uploaded.

emily: Publish succeeded. Closing thread. :shipit:
